mutations.name: S1 a text item no longer ends a tool group, so a call after a paragraph joins the calls before it and the paragraph reads as if it came after both
mutations.expectRed: grouping: a turn by a prompt, a prompt, a said paragraph, two calls, text, one call and a turn end give turn(prompt) prompt said tools(2) said tools(1) turnEnd
mutations.cell: grouping: a turn by a prompt, a prompt, a said paragraph, two calls, text, one call and a turn end give turn(prompt) prompt said tools(2) said tools(1) turnEnd

mutations.name: S3 the tool name falls back on falsiness, so an empty toolCallName reads ? and the fold disagrees with both renderers on absent versus empty
mutations.expectRed: tool name: an empty toolCallName is "", kept apart from an absent one
mutations.cell: tool name: an empty toolCallName is "", kept apart from an absent one

mutations.name: S4 posts are appended at the end instead of merged by time, so a post the agent made mid-turn shows after everything it did later
mutations.expectRed: post placement: a post at 10:58 between cotal_send at 10:58 and text at 10:59 lands between them and splits nothing it should not
mutations.cell: post placement: a post at 10:58 between cotal_send at 10:58 and text at 10:59 lands between them and splits nothing it should not

mutations.name: S5 a turn started by a message from the mesh is attributed to a prompt, which the wire never said
mutations.expectRed: turn source: a channel turn has source mesh
mutations.cell: turn source: a channel turn has source mesh

mutations.name: S6 an open stream is no longer cut at a run boundary, so a paragraph cut off mid-turn is drawn after every later turn instead of inside its own
mutations.expectRed: a stream open when its turn ends is drawn cut inside the turn
mutations.cell: a stream open when its turn ends is drawn cut inside the turn

mutations.name: S7 a message whose id is not a string is keyed by it anyway, so 7 and "7", or two messages with no id, share one key and the store drops one as a copy of the other
mutations.expectRed: a message whose id is not a string gives no frames, so it can never share a key with another message
mutations.cell: a message whose id is not a string gives no frames, so it can never share a key with another message

mutations.name: S8 the result marker is ignored, so a call that finished or failed never says so and every row reads as if the connector reported nothing
mutations.replace: const latest = undefined as ToolCall | undefined;
mutations.expectRed: work: a marker sets end and failed on its call
mutations.cell: work: a marker sets end and failed on its call

mutations.name: S9 tool status is always reported, so an older connector's calls claim running, done or failed states the wire never carried
mutations.expectRed: legacy: a closed turn of Write, Bash, Bash with no marker reads "Called Write, Bash and Bash"
mutations.cell: legacy: a closed turn of Write, Bash, Bash with no marker reads "Called Write, Bash and Bash"

mutations.name: S10 the group counts distinct tool names instead of calls, so two edits read as one
mutations.replace: for (const c of new Map(calls.map((x) => [x.name, x])).values()) counts.set(c.kind, (counts.get(c.kind) ?? 0) + 1);
mutations.expectRed: group title: two Edit calls read "Made 2 edits", counting calls, never files
mutations.cell: group title: two Edit calls read "Made 2 edits", counting calls, never files

mutations.name: S11 a call with no marker that something followed is left running, so a step the wire never said finished spins forever
mutations.expectRed: call state: a call with no marker that something followed is called, never running
mutations.cell: call state: a call with no marker that something followed is called, never running

mutations.name: S12 the work fold appends posts at the end instead of merging them by time, so a post made inside a finished turn lands in the open one
mutations.expectRed: work post placement: a channel post and a DM land inside the turn whose events surround them, the DM with to
mutations.cell: work post placement: a channel post and a DM land inside the turn whose events surround them, the DM with to

mutations.name: S13 precise is ignored, so a call that took 0.4s reads 0s
mutations.expectRed: formatDuration: 0.4s and 20.0s precise, 12s whole, 3m 2s, 1h 4m, and none for -1 or NaN
mutations.cell: formatDuration: 0.4s and 20.0s precise, 12s whole, 3m 2s, 1h 4m, and none for -1 or NaN

mutations.name: S14 a same-minute turn prints both ends, so its description reads 10:44 to 10:44
mutations.expectRed: turn description: a turn that starts and ends in the same minute shows one time
mutations.cell: turn description: a turn that starts and ends in the same minute shows one time

mutations.name: S15 the no-duration title for an open turn while waiting goes back to the bare Open, which reads like the page's Open links
mutations.expectRed: turn title: with no duration the titles read Worked, Turn failed, Working and Turn open
mutations.cell: turn title: with no duration the titles read Worked, Turn failed, Working and Turn open

mutations.name: S16 tool names are shown uncapped, so a harness can push any length of text into a title or description
mutations.expectRed: tool names: a 200-character name shows as its first 64 characters and …, and the call keeps it whole
mutations.cell: tool names: a 200-character name shows as its first 64 characters and …, and the call keeps it whole

mutations.name: S17 a call with no id is indexed for markers, so a marker for "" sets the result of whichever id-less call came last
mutations.expectRed: work: a call with no id is never matched by a marker, not even one for ""
mutations.cell: work: a call with no id is never matched by a marker, not even one for ""

mutations.name: S18 a post right after a cotal_send call is folded into the call, so the agent's verified message disappears behind a tool row
mutations.expectRed: work: a cotal_send call and its post stay separate steps, never joined
mutations.cell: work: a cotal_send call and its post stay separate steps, never joined
